worldconfig-diffusionTerrain-hover: Generate terrain with the Terrain Diffusion neural heightmap model instead of the vanilla landform generator. Requires the model files (~2.3 GB) to be downloaded once.
worldconfig-diffusionScale-hover: How many real-world metres one block represents. Smaller numbers spread every valley and mountainside over more blocks, so the landscape feels bigger to walk through, and the model runs less often per chunk. Larger numbers pack more distinct terrain into the same distance but make it all feel miniature.
worldconfig-diffusionScale-30: 30 m per block (most terrain per step)
worldconfig-diffusionVerticalExaggeratio: Multiplies terrain height above sea level. Terrain height is normally calibrated per world so the region's tallest peaks reach near the world ceiling, and 1x means exactly that; this is the taste knob on top of it. Above 1x the highest summits start flattening against the ceiling.
worldconfig-diffusionClimate-hover: How much of the climate the terrain model drives. The model's climate is a regional sample with no north-south gradient of its own, so 'regional' keeps latitude in charge of the broad temperature bands and lets the model add local character. 'Full' ignores latitude entirely.
vsterraindiffusion:command-elevation: Show the model elevation and climate at your position
